page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a one-to-one mapping of threads to physical cores, the instance provides dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile offers high resource density for memory-intensive workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs allows resource allocation to focus entirely on memory capacity and high-core-count compute. This configuration is designed for workloads such as large-scale databases, in-memory caching, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data processing pipelines.
